descriptors.R: nominee of the party of the administration in office since 1981, which also holds a majority in the Senate
descriptors.D: nominee of the party that held the presidency from 1977 to 1981 and holds a majority in the House

compile_desc.R: the party of the administration in office since 1981, which also holds a majority in the Senate
compile_desc.D: the party that held the presidency from 1977 to 1981 and holds a majority in the House

others_line: Other candidates on some ballots, including Libertarian and Citizens Party nominees and an independent (answer "other").
never_name: Reagan, Mondale, Bush, Ferraro, Carter, Hart, Jackson, Glenn, Bergland or LaRouche

slice_sources.men: 1980 and 1990 censuses interpolated to November 1984; men who are citizens 18+ (Twenty-sixth Amendment) outside the eleven Southern states: white non-Hispanic US-born, naturalized citizens of any race, Black US-born, and US-born Hispanic, Asian, Native American and other; 50 states and DC; calibrated to certified 1984 returns.
slice_sources.women: 1980 and 1990 censuses interpolated to November 1984; women who are citizens 18+ (Twenty-sixth Amendment) outside the eleven Southern states: white non-Hispanic US-born, naturalized citizens of any race, Black US-born, and US-born Hispanic, Asian, Native American and other; 50 states and DC; calibrated to certified 1984 returns.
slice_sources.south-white: 1980 and 1990 censuses interpolated to November 1984; citizens 18+ in the eleven former Confederate states other than Black US-born (white non-Hispanic US-born, naturalized of any race, and US-born Hispanic, Asian, Native American and other); calibrated to certified 1984 returns.
slice_sources.black-south: 1980 and 1990 censuses interpolated to November 1984; Black US-born citizens 18+ in the eleven former Confederate states; Voting Rights Act coverage continues (amended 1982). Any shortfall against white turnout is counted as exclusion.
slice_sources.immigrants: 1980 and 1990 censuses interpolated to November 1984; noncitizen adults of any race, who could not vote in any state.

masks: the nominee of the party out of power
a rival for the nomination of the party out of power
